status: finite gauge-fixed propagator, positivity, nonlinear gap-equation, longitudinal-pole and gauge-invariant correlator audit; not a continuum mass-gap proof

sameScreeningDifferentSpectra.decision: Equal finite D(0) and equal screening masses do not determine spectral positivity or a physical pole. The sign-changing gauge-fixed correlator has no nonnegative Kallen-Lehmann measure.

nonlinearGapEquation.interpretation: A nonlinear hierarchy can generate an exponentially small scale, but the value inherits kernel closure, renormalisation and boundary data. This algebraic toy is not a Yang-Mills DSE.

scalingDecoupling.decouplingProperty: finite nonzero transverse gluon propagator at p^2=0 and finite ghost dressing
scalingDecoupling.scalingProperty: infrared power-law relation with enhanced ghost and vanishing or suppressed gluon propagator
scalingDecoupling.decision: Gauge-fixed infrared boundary data can select distinct functional solutions; a decoupling solution is not by itself a unique gauge-invariant spectrum.

schwingerPoleTransversality.poleRole: longitudinally coupled composite 1/q^2 poles in vertices preserve Slavnov-Taylor identities while permitting nonzero Delta^-1(0)
schwingerPoleTransversality.nonPromotion: a longitudinal vertex pole is not automatically a positive-norm asymptotic massless particle, and a screened colored propagator is not a color-singlet Hamiltonian gap

positiveGaugeInvariantTarget.decision: A positive gauge-invariant spectral measure makes exponential decay and its lowest mass physically interpretable. This witness supplies rather than derives that measure.

functionalBoundStateStatus.advance: Matched DSE and Bethe-Salpeter truncations compute color-singlet glueball poles and agree quantitatively with lattice spectra in studied channels.
limitations: the full vertex hierarchy and bound-state kernel are truncated
the overall physical scale is supplied externally in representative calculations
a finite set of channels does not prove an all-channel lower bound
agreement does not construct the continuum measure or prove reflection positivity

proofAdmissionConditions: a regulator-defined continuum measure or equivalent exact complete DSE/FRG hierarchy
closure of all Slavnov-Taylor identities including longitudinal pole vertices with anomaly-free renormalisation
nilpotent renormalised BRST cohomology with positive physical inner product or equivalent gauge-invariant construction
gauge-parameter independence of physical poles, including Nielsen-identity control
bound-state kernels derived from the same effective action with ghosts and every potentially lighter channel
positive spectral measures for a separating family of gauge-invariant local operators
uniform positive spectral lower bound through infinite-volume, regulator-removal and continuum limits

spin23MethodologyOnly.transfer: physical-pole and cohomology methodology, not a group-theoretic scale

spin23MethodologyOnly.decision: Functional screening supplies no QCD-to-Spin(2,3) scale law.
